mapper.sql: e.id,e.tenant_id,e.shipment_order_id,e.exception_no,e.exception_type,e.status,e.description,e.reported_at,e.version,e.created_at,e.updated_at, (SELECT CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(a.detail,'$.assignedToUserId')) AS UNSIGNED) FROM audit_log a WHERE a.tenant_id=e.tenant_id AND a.resource_type='EXCEPTION_CASE' AND a.resource_id=e.id AND a.action_type='EXCEPTION_ASSIGN' ORDER BY a.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS assigned_to_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM shipment_order WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{orderId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tracking_event WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND id=#{trackingEventId})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{userId} AND status='ACTIVE' AND deleted=0)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM exception_case e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND e.status=#{status}
SELECT FROM exception_case e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.shipment_order_id=#{orderId} AND e.status=#{status} ORDER BY e.reported_at DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM exception_case e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{exceptionId}
SELECT FROM exception_case e WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.exception_no=#{exceptionNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE exception_case SET status=#{toStatus},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{exceptionId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT e.id AS exception_id,e.status AS exception_status,o.current_status AS order_status,o.currency AS order_currency FROM exception_case e JOIN shipment_order o ON o.id=e.shipment_order_id AND o.tenant_id=e.tenant_id WHERE e.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND e.id=#{exceptionId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM claim_record c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.id=#{claimId}
SELECT FROM claim_record c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.exception_case_id=#{exceptionId}
SELECT FROM claim_record c WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND c.claim_no=#{claimNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE claim_record SET status=#{toStatus},submitted_at=COALESCE(#{submittedAt},submitted_at),resolved_at=COALESCE(#{resolvedAt},resolved_at),version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{claimId} AND status=#{fromStatus} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT request_hash,resource_id FROM api_idempotency_record WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE api_idempotency_record SET resource_type=#{resourceType},resource_id=#{resourceId},processing_status='SUCCEEDED',response_status=201 WHERE scope_tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND operation_id=#{operationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO audit_log (tenant_id,operator_user_id,action_type,resource_type,resource_id,request_id,result_status,reason,detail,occurred_at) VALUES (#{tenantId},#{operatorUserId},#{actionType},#{resourceType},#{resourceId},#{requestId},'SUCCESS',#{reason},CAST(#{detail} AS JSON),#{occurredAt})
